name: Charm Moero! Mimikko
original_name: 魅惑 萌えろ！耳っ娘
source:
Main character is looking for a girlfriend, but only finds a strange pet in the park. He takes it home, but pet grows into a naughty girl. What's her true identity?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-july-2004-dear-my-friend.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角正在寻找女朋友，却在公园里发现了一只奇怪的宠物。他把它带回家，但宠物却变成了一个顽皮的女孩。她的真实身份是什么？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-july-2004-dear-my-friend.html]vndbreview[/url]]
